description: Contrarian first-principles brainstorming: deconstruct a topic to atomic truths, challenge every assumption, then rebuild radical alternatives. Use when conventional thinking has stalled. Put your TOPIC in the 'topic' parameter.

constraints.description: Any constraints or requirements to consider

files.description: File paths to read as code context. Supports line ranges: 'src/foo.ts:100-200'. Model sees ACTUAL CODE.

forceHeavy.description: Use expensive Grok 4 Heavy model ($3/$15) for deeper creativity

numIdeas.description: Number of radical rebuilds to generate (default: 5)

topic.description: The topic to brainstorm about (REQUIRED - put your idea/topic here)

name: grok_brainstorm
